messages.help.tap: Tap: [[P]] play or pause · [[Space]] the next line starts · [[Enter]] the current line ends (before a pause) · [[Backspace]] undo · [[⌘]]+[[S]] save. The highlighted line starts next. Keys mark times only while the song plays.
messages.help.adjust: Adjust: click a time to select it · [[↑]][[↓]] line · [[Tab]] start or end · [[Enter]] set to the playhead · [[←]][[→]] ±0.05 s · [[Shift]]+[[←]][[→]] ±0.5 s · [[Shift]]+click or [[Shift]]+[[↑]][[↓]] selects a range, [[⌘]]+click adds a line, [[⌘]]+[[A]] selects all; [[←]][[→]] then shift them together · [[R]] play from 2 s before · [[Space]] play or pause · drag markers in the lower waveform · [[Backspace]] undo · [[⌘]]+[[S]] save. The still shows the exact frame of the video at the playhead.
